caption: The drawing features a single object prominently centered on a plain, light beige background. The object is a spur, consisting of a brown leather strap in an oval shape, fastened with a metallic buckle. Attached to the strap is an ornate metal arm extending outward and curving slightly, with engraved decorative lines on its surface. At the end of the arm is a large, spiked rowel, depicted in dark metallic tones, with multiple pointed spokes radiating from the center. A short chain connects the metal part of the spur to the leather strap. The drawing contains subtle shading and highlights, giving the objects a three-dimensional effect. Near the bottom right corner, there is a small, simple artist's monogram or signature. The overall composition is minimal, with the object depicted in detail and occupying the central portion of the image.
title: Spur
